title: Basket
description: Defines a custom basket by referencing an identifier and its constituents.

identifier.description: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

taxonomy.description: Defines the taxonomy of an object by combining a taxonomy source (i.e. the rules to classify the object) and a value (i.e. the output of those rules on the object.

isExchangeListed.description: Defines whether the asset is listed on a public exchange.

party.description: The party with the obligation to pay dividends, coupons, or other payouts to the asset holder.

partyRole.description: The role of the payer specific to the asset type, i.e. bond, equity.

ancillaryPartyRole.description: The role of a party with indirect participation in the asset (i.e. transfer agent).

basketConstituent.description: Identifies the constituents of the basket
